using namespace std;

class IntList {
public:
    vector<int> data;
    int size = 0;

    bool isEmpty() {
        return size == 0;
    }

    int size() {
        return size;
    }

    int get(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) {
            throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        }
        return data[index];
    }

    void clear() {
        size = 0;
    }

    void set(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) {
            throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        }
        data[index] = value;
    }

    void expand() {
        if (size >= data.size()) {
            data.resize(data.size() * 2 + 1);
        }
    }

    void insert(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index > size) {
            throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        }
        expand();
        reverse(data.begin() + index, data.begin() + size);
        data[index] = value;
        reverse(data.begin() + index, data.begin() + size + 1);
        size++;
    }

    int delete(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) {
            throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        }
        int value = data[index];
        reverse(data.begin() + index, data.begin() + size);
        data.erase(data.begin() + index);
        reverse(data.begin() + index, data.begin() + size);
        size--;
        return value;
    }

    void push(int value) {
        expand();
        data.push_back(value);
        size++;
    }

    int pop() {
        if (size == 0) {
            throw out_of_range("List is empty");
        }
        int value = data.back();
        data.pop_back();
        size--;
        return value;
    }

    void unshift(int value) {
        expand();
        reverse(data.begin(), data.begin() + size);
        data.insert(data.begin(), value);
        reverse(data.begin(), data.begin() + size + 1);
        size++;
    }

    int shift() {
        if (size == 0) {
            throw out_of_range("List is empty");
        }
        int value = data.front();
        data.erase(data.begin());
        size--;
        return value;
    }
};

class IntIntMap {
public:
    static const int EMPTY = INT_MIN;

    vector<int> data;
    int size = 0;

    bool isEmpty() {
        return size == 0;
    }

    int size() {
        return size;
    }

    void clear() {
        for (int i = 0; i < data.size(); i += 2) {
            data[i] = EMPTY;
        }
        size = 0;
    }

    static int hash(int key) {
        int hash = key * 1000000007;
        hash ^= hash >> 16;
        hash ^= hash >> 24;
        return hash;
    }

    bool have(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) {
            throw invalid_argument("Key is empty");
        }
        for (int mask = data.size() - 2, i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                return true;
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    int get(int key, int default_) {
        if (key == EMPTY) {
            throw invalid_argument("Key is empty");
        }
        for (int mask = data.size() - 2, i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                return data[i + 1];
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                return default_;
            }
        }
    }

    static vector<int> resize(vector<int> data, int newCapacity) {
        int oldCapacity = data.size();
        vector<int> ndata(newCapacity);
        for (int i = 0; i < newCapacity; i += 2) {
            ndata[i] = EMPTY;
        }
        for (int mask = newCapacity - 2, i = 0; i < oldCapacity; i += 2) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == EMPTY) {
                continue;
            }
            for (int j = hash(cur) & mask;; j = (j - 1) & mask) {
                if (ndata[j] == EMPTY) {
                    ndata[j] = cur;
                    ndata[j + 1] = data[i + 1];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return ndata;
    }

    void set(int key, int value) {
        if (key == EMPTY) {
            throw invalid_argument("Key is empty");
        }
        vector<int> data = this->data;
        for (int capacity = data.size(), mask = capacity - 2, i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                data[i + 1] = value;
                return;
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                data[i] = key;
                data[i + 1] = value;
                if (++size > capacity >> 2) {
                    this->data = resize(data, capacity << 1);
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void delete(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) {
            throw invalid_argument("Key is empty");
        }
        vector<int> data = this->data;
        for (int capacity = data.size(), mask = capacity - 2, i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                for (int j = i;;) {
                    cur = data[j = (j - 1) & mask];
                    if (cur == EMPTY) {
                        data[i] = EMPTY;
                        --size;
                        return;
                    }
                    int k = hash(cur) & mask;
                    if ((k >= i) ^ (k < j) ^ (i < j)) {
                        data[i] = cur;
                        data[i + 1] = data[j + 1];
                        i = j;
                    }
                }
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void expand(int newCapacity) {
        vector<int> data = this->data;
        int oldCapacity = data.size();
        if (oldCapacity >> 2 < newCapacity) {
            this->data = resize(data, Integer::highestOneBit(newCapacity - 1) << 3);
        }
    }

    void shrink() {
        vector<int> data = this->data;
        int oldCapacity = data.size();
        if (oldCapacity > 4 && oldCapacity >> 3 >= size) {
            this->data = resize(data, max(Integer::highestOneBit(size - 1) << 3, 4));
        }
    }

    class Iterator {
    public:
        vector<int> data;
        int position = -2;

        Iterator(vector<int> data) {
            this->data = data;
            advance();
        }

        bool hasNext() {
            return position < data.size();
        }

        int getKey() {
            return data[position];
        }

        int getValue() {
            return data[position + 1];
        }

        void advance() {
            do {
                position += 2;
            } while (position < data.size() && data[position] == EMPTY);
        }
    };

    Iterator iterator() {
        return Iterator(data);
    }
};

vector<IntList> freeLists;

IntList takeList() {
    if (freeLists.empty()) {
        return IntList();
    } else {
        return freeLists.back();
        freeLists.pop_back();
    }
}

void putList(IntList list) {
    list.clear();
    freeLists.push_back(list);
}

int n, m;

IntList solve(int from, int to) {
    IntList res;
    if (from + 1 == to) {
        res = takeList();
        res.push(from);
        if (from + m > n) {
            res.push(n - from);
            res.push(from - n);
        }
        res.push(m);
        if (from > m) {
            res.push(n - from);
            res.push(from);
        }
        res.push(-from);
    } else {
        int mid = (from + to) >> 1;
        IntList a = solve(from, mid), b = solve(mid, to);
        res = takeList();
        int aSize = a.size(), bSize = b.size();
        int aData[] = a.data.data().data(), bData[] = b.data.data().data();
        for (int i = 0;; i += 2) {
            int bFrom = i == 0 ? 0 : bData[i - 1];
            int bTo = i == bSize - 1 ? n : bData[i + 1];
            int bShift = bData[i];
            int aFrom = bFrom + bShift;
            int aTo = bTo + bShift;
            int l = 0, r = aSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (aData[m] <= aFrom) {
                    l = m + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m - 1;
                }
            }
            int cur = l;
            while (true) {
                res.push(bShift + aData[cur]);
                ++cur;
                if (cur == aSize) {
                    break;
                }
                int pos = aData[cur];
                if (pos >= aTo) {
                    break;
                }
                res.push(pos - bShift);
                ++cur;
            }
            if (i == bSize - 1) {
                break;
            }
            res.push(bTo);
        }
        putList(a);
        putList(b);
    }
    return res;
}

void solve() {
    cin >> n >> m;
    int s = scanInt() - 1;
    long t = scanLong();
    for (int ct = (int)(t % n); ct != 0; ct--) {
        if (s < m) {
            s += ct;
            if (s >= n) {
                s -= n;
            }
        } else {
            s -= ct;
            if (s < 0) {
                s += n;
            }
        }
    }
    long cycles = t / n;
    if (cycles > 0) {
        IntList cycleSolve = solve(0, n);
        int csSize = cycleSolve.size(), csData[] = cycleSolve.data.data().data();
        IntList cycleList = takeList();
        IntIntMap cycleMap;
        for (int it = 0;; it++) {
            if (it == cycles) {
                break;
            }
            int prev = cycleMap.get(s, -1);
            if (prev >= 0) {
                s = cycleList.get(prev + (int)((cycles - prev) % (it - prev)));
                break;
            }
            cycleList.push(s);
            cycleMap.set(s, it);
            int l = 0, r = csSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (csData[m] <= s) {
                    l = m + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m - 1;
                }
            }
            s += csData[l];
        }
    }
    cout << s + 1;
}

int scanInt() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    return stoi(s);
}

long scanLong() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    return stol(s);
}

int main() {
    try {
        solve();
    } catch (exception& e) {
        cerr << e.what() << endl;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
